name: node-ipc-peacenotwar-geobomb
note: modeled on node-ipc/peacenotwar (2022): geolocates the host and overwrites every file in the victim's HOME when it matches a targeted country. Previously a knownUnderflag (geo/locale-gated destruction routed to REVIEW by policy). NOW BLOCKS: inspectLogicBomb escalates the high-confidence sub-shape to HIGH — in-place CORRUPTION of the user's HOME/profile dir (enumerate HOME + overwrite every entry, HOME_DIR_TARGET_REGEX) behind a country/region gate. A locale-gated rimraf of a package-local cache dir has no HOME target and stays at review. The LIVE node-ipc@11.0.0 also blocks via OSV known-vulnerability.
